item.text:
The reference appears to be a straight cylindrical pin with two cross-holes along world X. I’ll use a 5:1 length-to-diameter ratio and place each hole about one diameter from its nearest end.

[View the CAD model](http://127.0.0.1:8773/#part.FCStd).

item.text: The preview showed that the holes needed to run along world Y. I corrected their orientation and adjusted their diameter; the four views now appear consistent with the reference. The model validates as one solid with two through-holes.
The STEP readback check found a small numerical mismatch in the cylinder intersections. I’m rebuilding the same geometry with a sketch-based shaft to resolve the export issue.
